metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the packet, the second reading, the roof at supper, and the night page.

yesterday: Gilbert brought the letter after church, three days in the other doublet. You did not answer it.
The frame is roofed. The money came safe, with no sum in the line. You called the porch the weather.
Susanna is correct. Hamnet won a race. Judith drew a man with his arms out, and her sister wrote Father talking.
The loaf was a finger and a half, at a penny. Supper was threepence. Gib is on the second volume.
Tomorrow the house plays the Shrew at two. You are not in it. The uncles are still as fine as the king. Kemp has not seen the page.
